no_report_by_0730_utc.alarm_description: ST-2 AC-6: no complete report for the previous UTC day exists at 07:30 UTC. The report-worker's 07:30 UTC report.deadline-check emits CompleteReportAvailable=0 when the report is missing, incomplete or not generated.

report_deadline_check_missing.alarm_description: ST-2 AC-6: the report-worker has not emitted CompleteReportAvailable in the last 24 hours of 5-minute periods, so the 07:30 UTC check itself did not run and a missed report would go unnoticed. When the previous day's check emitted at 07:30 UTC, this fires by 07:35 UTC, before the 08:00 UTC deadline.
